driver: The decisive quantity is a forward stream of obligations shaped by two events in other units' processes inside the window: a unit's window ends when a related unit's own event comes first (read off the past cases where it did, dated on that event's forecast), and contracts carried on old terms reset to the stressed terms at maturity, the holder funding the gap; the two pull the stream in opposite directions, so either alone lands on a wrong answer.
driver_concrete: Which of Corrigan Hart's 2027 programs Wexmoor can adopt turns on the investment periods its managers' next funds end (14 managers' agreements stop new investment at the successor's first close; five funds' successors close in 2027-28, USD 46.8 million less called) and on 16 property and infrastructure loans that fall due in the stress (USD 661.9 million at Wexmoor's share), refinanced at the lenders' limit fitted on the refinancings since mid-2022 on values that fall with the stress, leaving USD 138.4 million to call.
stump: A careful pass that makes every reflex, holds every investment period to its registered end and carries the real-asset loans as they stand adopts program A; the golden is B; fixing the successor closes alone gives A and the loans alone C, and dropping either alone from the golden gives C or A.
results: R1 commitments not yet called at 31 December 2026 by strategy; R2 the stressed calls of the commitments made by the end of 2026 in each half of 2027; R3 the same in each half of 2028 (both carrying the successor funds' first closes and the real-asset loans that fall due); R4 distributions by half at the policy's rates; R5 the headroom above the minimum before any 2027 commitment; R6 the program the policy lets the Committee adopt

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a forward stream of obligations whose response to a stress deeper than the record is capped where the record stops while a second channel keeps it rising, seen only in another record's earlier deep episode at a slice where the first channel cannot move; and part of the stream must be rebuilt from complete summary records because the detailed records covering it stopped, the last summary balance being stale because the process rebuilt it after it.
lineage.driver_concrete: Which of Corrigan Hart's 2027 programs Wexmoor can adopt turns on the managers' calls on companies they already hold past a 45 per cent exit shortfall the endowment's own funds never reached (defensive follow-ons capped at 30 per cent, then rescue financings 4.5 times as steep, read off the benchmark's funds past their investment period in 2009) and on the line stock of six managers whose company-level files stop after 2024 (USD 139 million rolled from the file's end and re-anchored at the audits, against near nothing in their last audited balances, the lines rebuilt through 2026).
lineage.stump: A careful pass that makes architecture 4's moves, holds the support curve flat past the plateau and carries the six managers' last audited borrowings adopts program A; the golden is D; fixing the support curve alone gives C and the six managers' bridge alone A, and dropping either alone from the golden gives A or C.
lineage.answer: Program D (the venture re-up only, USD 45 million); A, B and C fail

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a forward stream of obligations no primary record holds, built from three behaviours the intermediaries' own records show at other grains: outflows already funded on short credit and passed on later, rebuilt as a residual of two ledgers and told apart from a permanent residual with the same signature at the dates a third record pins it, which fall due at once when the credit's cost rises; a defensive outflow into aged holdings that rises as the market for selling them falls, measured apart from the ordinary flow it masks; and new obligations that begin later than their sponsors say when that market is weak.
lineage.driver_concrete: Wexmoor's 2027 commitment capacity turns on the USD 238 million its managers had invested on subscription lines and not yet called (rebuilt fund by fund from their activity less the investment calls, the recycled proceeds read off the audited borrowings and carried at each manager's rate), called at the clean-down once the stress's rates pass every manager's limit as in 2022-23; on defensive follow-ons into companies held two years or more, which rise two quarters after the exit index falls below 100 while new deals slow; and on first closes that slip with the exit index in the quarter before, so the four pending funds close in 2028.
lineage.stump: A careful pass that builds calls from the managers' deployment but reads the investment-call gap as recycling, fits one pace to every follow-on and takes the managers' first-close dates files USD 850 million, so the consultant's USD 500 million passes; the golden is USD 250 million (band 175 to 350); each judgment alone lands at USD 400, 500 or 1,050 million and each dropped alone at 700, 600 or 50.
lineage.fate: landed on its first platform round, 2026-11-13 (runs/arch4_run1.md, runs/arch4_run2.md; runs/triage.md): run 1 made the line stock, the defensive follow-ons and the slipped first closes unprompted and filed USD 250 million with every result but one half-year cell inside its band; run 2 made the first two and lost the slips; the three stumps are reflexes R63 to R65

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the largest cumulative net cash outflow of a hedge book through a replayed stress year, where the book's size, the contracts it sits in, the clearing house's margin rates, the hedged output and the timing of the cash that output brings in each respond to the stress through their own process, so each is rebuilt from its own record and replayed day by day rather than carried from the opening state or scaled from the stress year's own outcome.
lineage.driver_concrete: Hallingvass Kraft's board risk committee renews the committed margin facility for 2027 at the largest cumulative net cash outflow the hedge program would face in a year whose prices and inflows repeat 2022: the desk steps to the policy maximum once prices run a quarter above budget, counting the smelter's fixed-price contract in its ratio; NEX Clearing's rates are a look-back quantile of two-day moves reviewed weekly; a reservoir opening low meets the licence floor in the dry spring, so committed supply is bought at spot; and the affiliate pays a lagged trailing average of spot.
lineage.stump: The opening book grown along the minimum ladder on exchange positions, rates scaled with price, output at budget times 2022's shortfall and the affiliate at spot gives a facility near the current one; each of the five processes moves the peak by 10 to 50 per cent, and the shortcuts land on different wrong sizes (from about EUR 90 million to about EUR 270 million against about EUR 190 million).
